name: Taparia WS-06 150mm Wire Cutter and Insulation Stripper
shortDescription: Precision drop-forged 150mm electrical wire cutter and wire stripper with knurled brass adjusting screw, return spring, and insulated comfort grips.
overview: The Taparia WS-06 is an essential electrician's hand tool engineered for clean, nick-free stripping and flush cutting of single-core and multi-strand copper and aluminium electrical wiring. Drop-forged from selected high-carbon tool steel with induction-hardened V-shaped cutting jaws, it features a knurled brass micro-adjusting screw with locknut that allows technicians to lock the blade opening to the exact conductor diameter, preventing accidental nicking or severing of inner strands during stripping.
keyFeatures: Drop-forged from high-grade carbon steel with induction-hardened cutting edges
V-shaped notch design provides rapid, concentric insulation stripping
Knurled brass adjusting stop screw with locknut sets precise wire gauge depth
Strips electrical cables cleanly from 0.5 sq mm up to 6 sq mm (10 – 24 AWG)
Integrated shear cutter cleanly slices copper and aluminium multi-strand cables
Smooth coil spring automatically reopens jaws to accelerate repetitive wiring tasks
Thick dual-dipped PVC vinyl handles provide non-slip electrical grip and comfort

specifications.Jaw Material: Drop Forged High Carbon Tool Steel
specifications.Adjustment: Brass Threaded Gauge Stop Screw with Knurled Locknut

applications: Industrial electrical control panel wiring and PLC harness routing
Commercial building conduit wiring, switch, and socket terminations
Automotive electrical loom fabrication and relay repairs
Telecom, audio-video, and networking cable installation
